# KIQA DEV — Kristian Gjergji

> Kristian Gjergji (KIQA DEV) is a developer based in Kosovo / Italy who builds mobile apps, websites, and web platforms for small businesses and founders. Fixed price, fixed delivery date, no middlemen.

## Services
- Mobile App — React Native, iOS & Android, Supabase backend, App Store + Play Store submission. From €799, delivered in 6 weeks.
- Landing Page — Next.js, 3D/animated, SEO-optimized, deployed on Vercel + Cloudflare. From €299, delivered in 7 days.
- Web Platform — Next.js, Supabase/PostgreSQL, user accounts, admin dashboard, real-time updates. From €1,299, delivered in 3 weeks.
- Custom Backend — Node.js, PostgreSQL, auth, file storage, live data sync. From €499, delivered in 2 weeks.

## Selected work
- Spindare — a social feed mobile app (React Native + Supabase), covering feed performance, authentication rebuild, and design system work.
- TravelMe AI — an AI-powered travel planning app using OpenAI for itinerary generation and recommendations.
